# Working with the Labour Force Survey

## Four exercises to learn to work with  the LFS

### 1. Estimates of temporary employment

A first exercise designed to help people get familar with the QLFS - size, key variables, the main weight, the effect of the grossing weight on counts.

### 2. The distribution of weekly earnings of full-time employees

A follow up exercise using the QLFS but focusing on earnings - key earnings variables, the earnings weight and when not to use the earnings weight.

### 3. Examining Labour Market Flows 

Using the Labour Force Survey Two-Quarter Longitudinal Dataset - introduces the longitudinal datasets - the structure of the dataset, key variables for examining flows, longitudinal weights

### 4 Accounting for survey design

Producing an estimate with CI using different weighting approaches, adjusting the CI using published design factors.
